hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Clean card layout, Inter font, muted edge color (#476376), and depth-opacity encoding show intentional choices, but the prominent FPS debug display, clashing green 'New Dataset' button, and the visualization cropping at the bottom of the viewport undercut the polish.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Structurally honest: scaleSqrt used for force-layout node sizing, data-driven domains via d3.extent, key functions present on all data joins, and no zero-baseline violations (no bar/area charts); minor caveat is the sunburst y-scale domain is hardcoded to the layout radius constant rather than derived from data max, but it coincides correctly with the partition output.
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: Tension slider fires redrawLinks() on 300 paths every input event with no RAF/debounce; no explicit .interrupt() before new transitions (mitigated by tween-tracked positions); no touch event filtering on drag or click handlers.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: 300 edge bundles over 200 nodes create a dense hairball in the default circle-pack view that can't be parsed without interaction; click-to-highlight mitigates this but the static state is visually overwhelming, and 200+ nodes morphing shapes simultaneously during layout transitions cannot be assessed for congruence from a screenshot.
